page.overview:
What is Hamid al-Samh?

Hamid al-Samh is an eighth generation Assamite and the sire of Ziyad al-Djahiz.

During the Crusades, Ziyad petitioned his sire to participate, although he was stopped from interfering in the direct battles. Instead, Hamid and the childe assassinated those that they could not manipulate, turning the Crusaders against themselves.
